mapper.select: SELECT SUM(wrd.receive_qty) receive_qty FROM warehouse_receive_detail wrd LEFT JOIN warehouse_receive wr ON wrd.main_id = wr.id AND wrd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE wrd.is_deleted = FALSE AND wr.purchase_order_id = #{PurchaseOrderId} AND wrd.skuId = #{skuId}

SELECT pro.id, pro.code, pro.purchase_order_code, pro.supplier_name, pro.approve_status, pro.invalid_status, prod.sku_no, pro.bill_date, pro.return_warehouse_name, prod.reality_return_qty, pro.return_remark, pro.return_mode, pro.purchase_user_id, pro.return_user_name, prod.remark, pro.approve_user_name, pro.create_user_name, pro.create_time, prod.purchase_order_detail_id FROM purchase_return_order_detail prod LEFT JOIN purchase_return_order pro ON prod.main_id = pro.id AND prod.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pro.is_deleted = FALSE AND pro.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId}
